thread.title: Apple stores are slammed because of the $29 battery replacement offer — but not everyone needs a new battery (AAPL)

title: Apple stores are slammed because of the $29 battery replacement offer — but not everyone needs a new battery (AAPL)
text:
Facebook 
Apple is currently offering iPhone battery replacements for $29. Lots of people are taking advantage of the offer, and since stores don't have the batteries in stock, they're special ordering the battery replacements, which can take days or weeks. Apple retail stores are struggling to handle a surge of customers looking to reinvigorate their iPhones with a special battery replacement procedure.
